questions.prompt: How many loose objects did count-objects report before gc?
How many loose objects are there after gc?
In verify-pack -v output, a line ending with a number and a second object id means:
options: The object is stored as a delta against that second object, at that chain depth
The object is corrupt and that id is its replacement
The object is a merge of the two ids
The object is duplicated in another pack

questions.prompt: Which objects are good candidates for deltas?
options: Objects with similar content, like successive versions of one file
Objects created on the same day

goals.label: Inspect the pack with git verify-pack
Say what deltas are good for
